She leans closer.

Gail carries the basket through.

His name is Jack.
He wears a blue scarf and feels very hungry.
Gail opens the basket for Jack.
He shakes his head.
He is picky and only eats his favorite foods.
Jack steps back from the berries.
He thinks they may be too sour.
Gail asks if he has tried them.
Gail holds up a fresh, crunchy carrot.
Jack folds his arms and says no.

Jack is quiet.

First, Jack looks at the shapes and colors.
The berries are red and purple.
Next, Jack smells the carrot, berries, and sandwich.
He is surprised that the berries smell sweet.

It goes crunch!

english: Gail is in her familiar bedroom wearing her purple star pajamas. A woven basket rests beside her bed. She does not remember putting it there.
The basket begins to glow. Inside are fresh, colorful foods: berries, a carrot, and a green sandwich. Gail leans closer.
A warm light rises from the basket and opens a path into a forest. Gail carries the basket through the doorway. There is no bear in her bedroom; Jack appears only after she reaches the forest.
Deep in the forest, Gail hears a loud rumble. “Grrr-rumble!” It does not sound angry. It sounds hungry.
A big brown bear steps out from behind a tree. He wears a blue scarf. “I’m Jack,” he says. “And I’m very hungry.”
Gail opens the basket. Jack looks inside and shakes his head. “I’m picky,” he says. “I only eat my favorite foods.”
Gail offers the berries. Jack steps back. “No berries! They might be too sour.” Gail asks, “Have you tried them?” Jack looks away.
Gail holds up the carrot. “It is fresh and crunchy.” Jack folds his arms. “No carrots!”
Next comes the sandwich with lettuce and cucumber. Jack makes a face. “Too green!”
Gail sits beside the basket. “How do you know you do not like them if you never take a bite?” Jack is quiet.
Gail smiles. “Let’s play the Brave Bite Game. You do not have to finish anything. Just choose one food and try one little bite.”
They spread the foods out like a small picnic. Jack looks at the shapes and colors. The berries shine red and purple.
Jack smells the carrot, berries, and sandwich. “The berries smell sweet,” he says, surprised.
Jack chooses one berry. He takes one small, brave bite. Gail waits without pushing him.
Then Jack tries a thin piece of carrot. “CRUNCH!” His eyes grow wide. “It is really crunchy!”
Jack takes a small bite of the sandwich. He tastes the lettuce and cucumber. “It is fresh,” he says.
Jack thinks for a moment. “The cucumber is not my favorite.” Gail nods. “That is okay. Trying does not mean you have to love everything.”
Jack looks over the food again and chooses what he wants for lunch. He picks berries, carrot, and part of the sandwich.
Gail and Jack share a colorful picnic under the trees. The basket sits between them. Jack is still picky about some foods, but now he is willing to try.
The basket begins to glow again. Before Gail leaves, Jack smiles and says, “Next time, I’ll try one little bite.” Gail carries the basket home, and Jack stays in the forest with his blue scarf.
chinese: 瑜瑜穿著紫色星星睡衣待在熟悉的房間裡。床邊出現一只藤編籃子，她不記得自己把它放在那裡。
籃子開始發光。裡面有新鮮又色彩繽紛的食物：莓果、胡蘿蔔，還有一份綠色三明治。瑜瑜好奇地靠近。
溫暖的光從籃子升起，打開通往森林的道路。瑜瑜提著籃子穿過入口。房間裡沒有熊；Jack 只在她進入森林後才出現。
走進森林後，瑜瑜聽見很大的咕嚕聲。「咕嚕——！」聽起來不像生氣，比較像肚子餓。
一隻大棕熊從樹後走出來，脖子上圍著藍色領巾。「我是 Jack，」他說，「而且我好餓。」
瑜瑜打開籃子。Jack 看了一眼就搖頭。「我很挑食，」他說，「我只吃我最喜歡的食物。」
瑜瑜拿出莓果。Jack 往後退：「不要莓果！它們可能太酸了。」瑜瑜問：「你有吃過嗎？」Jack 把頭轉開。
瑜瑜拿起胡蘿蔔：「它很新鮮，而且脆脆的。」Jack 抱起手臂：「不要胡蘿蔔！」
接著是夾著生菜和小黃瓜的三明治。Jack 皺起臉：「太綠了！」
瑜瑜坐在籃子旁：「如果你從來沒有咬一口，怎麼知道自己不喜歡？」Jack 安靜下來。
瑜瑜笑著說：「我們來玩『勇敢一口』遊戲。你不用全部吃完，只要選一樣，勇敢試一小口。」
她們把食物排開，像一場小野餐。Jack 先看看不同的形狀和顏色，莓果閃著紅色和紫色。
Jack 聞了胡蘿蔔、莓果和三明治。「莓果聞起來甜甜的。」他有些驚訝。
Jack 選了一顆莓果，勇敢地咬了一小口。瑜瑜在旁邊等，沒有催他。
接著 Jack 試了一小片胡蘿蔔。「喀滋！」他的眼睛睜大了：「真的脆脆的！」
Jack 咬了一小口三明治，吃到生菜和小黃瓜。「原來很清爽。」他說。
Jack 想了一下：「小黃瓜不是我的最愛。」瑜瑜點點頭：「沒關係。願意嘗試，不代表每一樣都一定要喜歡。」
Jack 再看一次所有食物，選擇自己的午餐。他挑了莓果、胡蘿蔔和一部分三明治。
瑜瑜和 Jack 在樹下分享一場色彩繽紛的野餐，籃子放在兩人中間。Jack 還是有些食物不喜歡，但現在願意先試試看。
籃子再次發光。瑜瑜離開前，Jack 笑著說：「下次，我會先試一小口。」瑜瑜提著籃子回家，戴著藍色領巾的 Jack 留在森林裡。
